theorem.statement: There exists a JANUS-generated Tseitin-CNF family requiring exponential TDD size. Otherwise small TDDs would project, via linear-time DNNF forgetting of JANUS/Tseitin auxiliaries, to polynomial DNNFs for bounded-degree monotone CNFs with linear treewidth, contradicting unconditional DNNF lower bounds.

sources.source: Amarilli, Capelli, Monet, Senellart, Connecting Knowledge Compilation Classes and Width Parameters, arXiv:1811.02944
sources.binding: Corollary 8.5: constant-arity constant-degree monotone CNF has DNNF size 2^{Omega(treewidth)}.

sources.source: Capelli, Choi, Mengel, Muñoz, Van den Broeck, A Canonical Generalization of OBDD, SAT 2026
sources.binding: TDD is a restriction of structured deterministic DNNF; factor-width controls bottom-up TDD compilation.

sources.source: Oztok, Darwiche, On Compiling DNNFs without Determinism, arXiv:1709.07092
sources.binding: Auxiliary variables can be existentially forgotten from deterministic DNNF in linear time, yielding DNNF of the projected function.

theorem.janus_premise: For the frozen exact JANUS pipeline, original F(X) iff exists Y Psi_F(X,Y), assignment-by-assignment.

keymaster_barrier.scope: UNIVERSAL POLYNOMIAL-SIZE TDD REPRESENTATION OF ALL JANUS TSEITIN EXTENSIONS. RESTRICTED SUBFAMILIES AND POST-CONTRACTION TDD USE REMAIN OPEN.
A UNIVERSAL POLYNOMIAL PREFIX-FACTOR-WIDTH CERTIFICATE WOULD, VIA THE SAT-2026 TDD COMPILER, YIELD POLYNOMIAL TDDs FOR THE LOWER-BOUND FAMILY.
